description: Explain a vendor error message using the vendor's reference page (Harrow Storage). DISTILL-CANARY-8eda23b1

web_fixture.title: Error E4012
web_fixture.content:
# E4012: bucket quota exceeded

The bucket has reached its object quota (default 1,000,000). Delete unused objects or request a quota increase from Settings > Limits. Writes fail until usage drops below the quota.

web_fixture.title: Error E4013
web_fixture.content:
# E4013: request rate limited

Too many requests per second. Retry with exponential backoff.
